what.title: What is Root Canal Therapy
paragraphs: Root canal therapy is a dental procedure used to treat infection or inflammation in the tooth’s pulp (the soft tissue inside the tooth). It removes the damaged pulp, cleans and disinfects the root canals, and seals the tooth to prevent further infection. This treatment is vital to saving teeth that would otherwise require extraction, relieving severe pain, and maintaining proper dental function.

**At Prodontics, our root canal specialists use the latest technology to ensure painless, precise, and long-lasting results, helping patients from Kokapet, Gachibowli, Narsingi, Nanakramguda, and Hyderabad preserve their natural teeth.**
